title: Enhanced Wound Healing Potential of Spirulina platensis Nanophytosomes: Metabolomic Profiling, Molecular Networking, and Modulation of HMGB-1 in an Excisional Wound Rat Model.
authors: Refai, Hanan; El-Gazar, Amira A; Ragab, Ghada M; Hassan, Doaa H; Ahmed, Omar S; Hussein, Rehab A; Shabana, Samah; Waffo-Teguo, Pierre; Valls, Josep; Al-Mokaddem, Asmaa K; Selim, Heba Mohammed Refat M; Yousef, Einas Mohamed; Ali, Sahar K; Salman, Ahmed; Abo-Zalam, Hagar B; Albash, Rofida
one_liner_zh: 该文研究螺旋藻纳米囊泡促进伤口愈合，涉及代谢组学与HMGB-1蛋白分子对接，但核心是湿实验与药物递送，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Excisional wounds are considered one of the most common physical injuries. This study aims to test the effect of a nanophytosomal formulation loaded with a dried hydroalcoholic extract of S. platensis on promoting excisional wound healing. The Spirulina platensis nanophytosomal formulation (SPNP) containing 100 mg PC and 50 mg CH exhibited optimum physicochemical characteristics regarding particle size (598.40 +/- 9.68 nm), zeta potential (-19.8 +/- 0.49 mV), entrapment efficiency (62.76 +/- 1.75%), and Q6h (74.00 +/- 1.90%). It was selected to prepare an HPMC gel (SPNP-gel). Through metabolomic profiling of the algal extract, thirteen compounds were identified. Molecular docking of the identified compounds on the active site of the HMGB-1 protein revealed that 12,13-DiHome had the highest docking score of -7.130 kcal/mol. SPNP-gel showed higher wound closure potential and enhanced histopathological alterations as compared to standard (MEBO((R)) ointment) and S. platensis gel in wounded Sprague-Dawley rats. Collectively, NPS promoted the wound healing process by enhancing the autophagy process (LC3B/Beclin-1) and the NRF-2/HO-1antioxidant pathway and halting the inflammatory (TNF-, NF-kappaB, TlR-4 and VEGF), apoptotic processes (AIF, Caspase-3), and the downregulation of HGMB-1 protein expression. The present study's findings suggest that the topical application of SPNP-gel possesses a potential therapeutic effect in excisional wound healing, chiefly by downregulating HGMB-1 protein expression.
abstract_zh: 切除性伤口被认为是最常见的身体损伤之一。本研究旨在测试负载干燥螺旋藻水醇提取物的纳米植物脂质体制剂对促进切除性伤口愈合的效果。含有100 mg PC和50 mg CH的螺旋藻纳米植物脂质体制剂（SPNP）在粒径（598.40 ± 9.68 nm）、Zeta电位（-19.8 ± 0.49 mV）、包封效率（62.76 ± 1.75%）和Q6h（74.00 ± 1.90%）方面表现出最佳理化特性。该制剂被选用于制备HPMC凝胶（SPNP-gel）。通过藻类提取物的代谢组学分析，鉴定出13种化合物。对鉴定化合物在HMGB-1蛋白活性位点上的分子对接显示，12,13-DiHome具有最高的对接得分，为-7.130 kcal/mol。与标准药物（MEBO®软膏）和螺旋藻凝胶相比，SPNP-gel在受伤的Sprague-Dawley大鼠中表现出更高的伤口闭合潜力和改善的组织病理学变化。总体而言，NPS通过增强自噬过程（LC3B/Beclin-1）和NRF-2/HO-1抗氧化通路，并抑制炎症（TNF-、NF-kappaB、TlR-4和VEGF）和凋亡过程（AIF、Caspase-3），以及下调HGMB-1蛋白表达，促进了伤口愈合过程。本研究的发现表明，SPNP-gel的局部应用在切除性伤口愈合中具有潜在的治疗效果，主要通过下调HGMB-1蛋白表达实现。
